verdict.rationale: Luma's Modify Video V2 lets you swap specific elements (the wall, the wardrobe) in existing footage while the lighting and performance are preserved, which covers the core of the story. The docs are marketing-level only: there is no documented region or mask targeting that confines changes to one element, and "swap the world" suggests whole-scene restyling rather than guaranteed preservation of the rest of the frame. Missing for 10: documented element-level isolation/masking that keeps the rest of the frame unchanged, in-depth docs or API parameters for element replacement, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can replace or restyle an element inside an existing video while the rest of the frame stays intact

citations.quote: Modify Video V2 reshapes footage you already have. Swap the wall, the world, the wardrobe. The lighting holds. The performance survives.
Transform people into entirely new characters while preserving performance.
Adapt products across campaigns without reshoots or manual editing.
